name: Karen Blixen Camp
positioning: Luxury safari camp in the Mara North Conservancy in the Masai Mara, with guided game walks and a resident head guide
best_for: Safari travelers who want game walks as well as game drives
Photographers and travelers who like to set their own pace each day

facts.text: Karen Blixen Camp is a luxury safari camp in the Mara North Conservancy in the Masai Mara.
The camp offers guided game walks.
Simon Saidimu is the head guide at Karen Blixen Camp.
The head guide, Simon Saidimu, has led guests to watch the Great Migration at the Mara River in the Mara Triangle.
Bird watching is part of every game drive.
The Karen Blixen Camp Trust introduced bee hives within the camp as an eco-fencing initiative.
The bee hive eco-fencing aims to deter elephants from entering the camp.
Honey harvesting season begins at the camp as the dry season ends.
Karen Blixen Camp Trust is a Kenyan nonprofit organization in the Masai Mara.
Together with the Karen Blixen Camp Trust, the camp runs community projects for the host Maasai community.

highlights.text: Guests can go out on guided game walks, not only game drives.
The head guide, Simon Saidimu, has taken guests to watch the Great Migration at the Mara River in the Mara Triangle.
At Karen Blixen Camp, guests can shape the flow of each day.
Bee hives inside the camp act as eco-fencing to deter elephants.

considerations.text: Guests come to the camp by car or by air.
WhataHotel notes the remote wilderness location requires bush flights or long drives.
